notes: The catalogue records King Jitāmitra Malla (king of Bhaktapur and author of the Madālasāharaṇanāṭaka), but his name does not appear in the transcribed colophon text. The transcribed section contains theatrical text, stage directions with mythological characters (Aśvatara, Kambala, Gālava), the completion/production note 'saṃvat 807 madārasāharana dayakā', and drum syllables (bols).
